label: Allow Tool Recording
params_doc: {"enabled":bool?=toggle} → {enabled:bool}. Opt in to recording painting-tool strokes (off initially). Existing pending steps are committed under the previous mode. Painting, history and the journal are unchanged. actions.list reports toolRecording.

label: Move to Set
params_doc: {"action":name|index, "set":name|null} → {action, set}. The set folder the Actions panel shows the action under (what Load Actions fills and Save Actions writes); null takes it out of any set.

label: Clear All Actions
params_doc: {"confirm":true} → {cleared}. Removes every action and set, empty ones included, and the action shortcuts. Undo with actions.undoLibrary.

label: Conditional
params_doc: {"if":condition, "then":action name|null, "else":action name|null} → {if, holds, played, ran?, failed?}. Photoshop's Insert Conditional: conditions always|never|isOpen|landscape|square|portrait|modeIsRGB|modeIsCMYK|modeIsGrayscale|modeIsLab|modeIsBitmap|modeIsIndexed|modeIsDuotone|modeIsMultichannel|depth8|depth16|depth32|unsaved|hasSelection|hasLayers|hasAlphaChannels|isBackground|isPixelLayer|isAdjustmentLayer|isShapeLayer|isTypeLayer|isSmartObject|isLayerGroup|isLocked|isVisible|hasPixelMask|hasVectorMask|hasEffects (layer conditions test the active layer). The branch plays as actions.play does; its failure stops the calling action.

label: Delete Action
params_doc: {"action":name|index, "step":index?} → {deleted:name} or {action, deletedStep, steps:count}. step is 0-based, including pending recorded steps. Whole-action deletion is refused while recording.

label: Toggle Step Dialog
params_doc: {"action":name|index, "step":index?, "enabled":bool?} → {action, dialogs:[step…]}. The Actions panel's dialog toggle: the desktop shell shows the step's dialog, seeded with its recorded params, and resumes playback when it is confirmed; headless playback runs the recorded params. Omitted enabled flips it; without step, every step: on unless all already are, or as enabled says.

label: Duplicate Action
params_doc: {"action":name|index,"step":index?} or {"set":name} → {action?,index?,step?,steps?,set?,actions?}. Copy an action, step or named set below the source. Copies retain settings and flags, and leave shortcuts with the originals.

label: Get Action
params_doc: {"action":name|index} → {name, steps:[[id, params]…], disabled:[step…], dialogs:[step…], set:name|null, color:str} (steps is the shape file.automate.batch and droplets take; disabled lists the 0-based steps playback skips; dialogs the steps whose dialog Photoshop would show; set the action set from Load Actions; color is the Button Mode swatch, or empty)

label: Insert Step
params_doc: {"action":name|index, "id":command id, "params":{}?, "at":index?=end} → {action, step, id, steps}. Inserts a step at the 0-based position (the reference application's Insert Stop… with id actions.stopMessage, its dialog toggle on; Insert Menu Item… with any command). Pending recorded steps count; flags of the steps after it follow them.

label: Insert Menu Item…
params_doc: {"action":name|index,"id":menu command,"at":index?,"eventKind":"name"|"code"="name"} → {action,step,id,steps}. Records an unambiguous supported menu event without settings. Image Size and mapped filter menu events are supported. Desktop playback opens the existing editor when settings are needed; no-settings items run immediately.

label: Insert Path
params_doc: {"action":name|index,"name":"work"|"layer"|saved path name,"at":index?} → {action,step,id,steps}. Snapshot exactly the selected path as a path.set work-path step, preserving cubic handles and path options. No fallback from a missing Work Path to a layer path. The measured Work Path ATN descriptor supports absolute coordinates, cubic handles, even-odd subpaths and Add/Subtract/XOR. Paths outside that measured form still play natively and are reported as unsupported by ATN export.

label: List Actions
params_doc: {} → {actions:[{name, steps:count, set:name|null}], sets:[name…] (every set in panel order, empty ones too), recording:name|null, toolRecording:bool}

label: Load Actions…
params_doc: {"path":".atn file"?,"data":base64 bytes?,"set":name? (override the file's set name),"replace":bool=true (replace the actions of a set of the same name),"encoding":"auto"|label="auto" (the encoding of 8-bit step names: shift_jis, gbk, big5, euc-kr, windows-1252, macintosh…; auto works it out)} → {set, actions:[names], steps, unsupported:[{action, step, event, name}], functionKeys:[{action, key}], warnings, encoding}. Photoshop steps PhotoCraft cannot play become actions.photoshopStep steps (kept for Save Actions; they fail at playback with the step's name); tool selections and other steps with no document effect are imported switched off. Layer references by name replay in any document.

label: Move Action or Step
params_doc: {"action":name|index, "step":index?, "to":index}. Move a step within its action, or the action itself. to is the final zero-based index. Pending recorded steps can be moved.

label: New Set
params_doc: {"name":str? (default "Set N")} → {set}. An empty set folder in the Actions panel, as Photoshop's New Set… makes; New Action records into the selected set (actions.record's `set`). Save Actions… (actions.save's `set`) writes it even while empty, and the preset store keeps it between sessions.

label: Play Action
params_doc: {"action":name|index, "from":step?} → {action, ran, failed?:{step, id, error}}. step and from are 0-based; steps switched off with actions.toggle are skipped. Stops at the first error (the command still returns ok, with failed set) and groups document edits in one Action: <name> history entry by default; actions.setHistory can retain per-step history. Nested calls are supported up to 16 levels; cycles are rejected. Recording stores a named call rather than its expanded commands. Each step is checked with Session::authorize when one is installed.

label: Record Action
params_doc: {"name":str? (new action, default "Action N"),"set":name? (the set it goes in, as New Action records into the selected set)} or {"action":name|index} (append) → {action, index}

label: Record Again
params_doc: {"action":name|index,"step":index,"params":{new settings},"revision":u64?} → {action,step,id,result}. Replays the selected command and stores its new settings only after success, preserving its enabled/dialog flags. The panel opens the command's editor at the recorded settings. Stop recording or playback first; revision optionally rejects stale library state.

label: Rename Action
params_doc: {"action":name|index, "name":str} → {action, index}. The name must not be empty or whitespace-only and must be unique. Nested Play Action steps and the action's function key follow the rename.

label: Replace Actions…
params_doc: {"path":".atn file"?,"data":base64?,"confirm":true,"encoding":label?} → {sets,actions,warnings,unsupported}. Replaces the whole library with every set of the ATN archive (a set name or action name the archive repeats gets a numbered name) and the action shortcuts with its function keys. Undo with actions.undoLibrary.

label: Reset Actions…
params_doc: {"confirm":true,"mode":"replace"|"append"} → {set,appended,actions:[names]}. Restores the PhotoCraft Basics set; appended beside a set of that name it gets a numbered name.

label: Save Actions…
params_doc: {"path":".atn file"? (else the bytes come back as base64 `data`),"set":name? (that set's actions, none for an empty New Set set; default: every action, as the set "PhotoCraft Actions"),"action":name|index? (one action),"skipUnsupported":bool=false (leave out steps with no Photoshop equivalent instead of failing)} → {set, actions:[names], steps, bytes, skipped:[{action, step, id}], path|data}

label: Set Action Color
params_doc: {"action":name|index, "color":""|"red"|"orange"|"yellow"|"green"|"blue"|"violet"|"gray"} → {action, color}. The Button Mode colour. Empty clears it.

label: Set Actions History
params_doc: {"singleState":bool} → {singleState}. Persist Create a single history state (default true). Playback Options can use this setting without changing its performance mode.

label: Playback Options
params_doc: {"performance":"accelerated"|"step"|"pause"?, "seconds":1..60?, "singleState":bool?} → {performance, seconds, singleState}. The Actions panel menu's Playback Options, saved in preferences (`actions.performance`, `actions.pauseSeconds`, `actions.createSingleHistoryState`). Step by Step and Pause For pace a person's Play in the app, about one second between steps plus Pause For's whole seconds; actions.play from agents, the CLI and Batch always runs at once. Omitted keys keep their value; {} reads them. Every value is checked before any is stored.

label: Stop Recording
params_doc: {} → {action, steps:count} (steps recorded since actions.record, queries and action-editing commands omitted)

label: Toggle Action Steps
params_doc: {"action":name|index, "step":index?, "enabled":bool?} → {action, disabled:[step…]}. Switch one 0-based step (including pending recorded steps) on or off for playback, Batch and droplets; omitted enabled flips it. Without step, switch every step: on unless all already are, or as enabled says.

label: Undo Actions Library Change
params_doc: {} → {undone}. Restores the library and action shortcuts from before the latest Clear All, Reset or Replace without editing document History.
